Have breakfast and enjoy some free time in Lima. At the scheduled time, transfer to the airport for your flight to Bogotá.

On arrival at El Dorado Airport, you'll be met and taken to your hotel to check in. The rest of the day is free. After the Peruvian highlands, the journey takes a different turn, starting in the Colombian capital and continuing to the Caribbean coast.

Lima airport approach road, terminal and control tower
Bogotá: Historic Centre, Gold Museum and Monserrate

After breakfast, meet your English-speaking guide at 09:00 for a sightseeing tour of Bogotá’s historic centre.

The old quarters still have colonial churches, narrow streets, squares and historic buildings from the 17th to the 19th century. The newer districts have a different feel, with high-rise buildings, cafés, restaurants and shops.

Visit the Gold Museum, which houses a large collection of pre-Columbian objects, including masks, diadems, bracelets, ritual figures and symbols of power. Then visit the house museum associated with Simón Bolívar to learn about his life and work in Colombia.

Take the funicular up Monserrate, a hill about 3,200 metres above sea level with panoramic views over Bogotá. The 17th-century San Vicente monastery stands at the summit. The tour continues at the Fernando Botero Museum. Afterwards, return to the hotel or transfer to a local restaurant to try Colombian cuisine.
